name: Numerals Enterprise Constitution
description: The constitution every Numerals division inherits. Inheritance is minimum harmonisation: a division may tighten an enterprise provision and may never loosen one; an enterprise absolute is a floor in every division. Records on enterprise provisions bind enterprise-wide; a division's own record is narrower in scope and wins on the ordering rule's scope key.

standing_declaration.note: A9 first limb at the enterprise level: the group compliance office holds contest standing adverse to grants in every division.
